description: This file defines the 'snapshot' struct representing a read-only snapshot of a span's state in OpenTelemetry tracing SDK, including methods to access span properties and metadata.

classes.name: snapshot
classes.description: A read-only representation of a span's state at a specific checkpoint, used within OpenTelemetry SDK.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the span.

methods.name: SpanContext
methods.description: Returns the unique SpanContext that identifies the span.

methods.name: Parent
methods.description: Returns the SpanContext of the parent span, or invalid if none.

methods.name: SpanKind
methods.description: Returns the role of the span in a trace.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the span.

methods.name: EndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the span, zero if not ended.

methods.name: Attributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the span.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Returns all links to other spans.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns all events within the span's lifetime.

methods.name: InstrumentationScope
methods.description: Returns information about the scope that created the span.

methods.name: InstrumentationLibrary
methods.description: Returns information about the instrumentation library that created the span.

methods.name: Resource
methods.description: Returns information about the entity that produced the span.

methods.name: DroppedAttributes
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes dropped due to limits.

methods.name: DroppedLinks
methods.description: Returns the number of links dropped due to limits.

methods.name: DroppedEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events dropped due to limits.

methods.name: ChildSpanCount
methods.description: Returns the count of child spans that consider this span a parent.
